verdict.rationale: Metorial is an MCP integration and tool-access platform, so a background-automation axis fairly applies. However, the evidence shows no product-native triggers, schedules, or autonomous background runs. The sample bots (daily standup, interview coordinator) are apps developers build themselves with the SDK, which makes them developer building blocks, not a shipped capability. Magic Skills package repeatable workflows but are not documented as running autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
